# Event Block

`events/event-block` &middot; section-level &middot; category: events

## Purpose

An event: title, date, time, location, description, speaker and a button, with the details as a label/value table.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text |  |
| `date` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `time` | text |  |
| `location` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `speaker` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Left-aligned event on the surface color.
- **centered**: Centered event. Sets `align: center`.
- **dark**: White text on the primary color. Sets `background: @colors.primary`, `buttonBackground: @colors.primaryText`, `buttonColor: @colors.primary`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored, the details are a plain table. | Fine. | Swaps via dm-* classes on the brand surface. The dark variant keeps its colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('events/event-block', {
  "eyebrow": "Live workshop",
  "title": "Natural dyeing for beginners",
  "date": "Saturday 20 June 2026",
  "time": "11:00 am to 1:00 pm PT",
  "location": "Our Portland studio, 214 Alder Street",
  "description": "Learn to dye linen with plants you can grow at home. All materials and a take-home swatch set are included.",
  "speaker": "Elena Ruiz, textile artist",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Reserve my place",
    "href": "https://example.com/events/natural-dyeing"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "events/event-block",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "Live workshop",
    "title": "Natural dyeing for beginners",
```
